title: Gemma on LM Studio: replaying one request variable at a time
summary: Finds how Gemma's replies depend on response_format, token cap and capability list size.

setup.method: replay one variable at a time

results.object_or_strict_schema: Gemma loops about 10 KB in `summary` (finish: length)
results.no_response_format: completes only with 8192 tokens (4519 tokens, 4358 of them reasoning)
results.capability_list: 10 capabilities: length_limited 3/3; 8 capabilities: completed and grounded 3/3

limitations: Decoding at temperature 0.0 on this server is not repeatable.

reproduce.command: not reproducible from the repository (script not committed)
needs: a local model server (LM Studio / oMLX / llama.cpp) on the author's machine

comparability: One model on one server; mechanism evidence, not a rate.
